refs.licence: CC0 (The Met Open Access, public domain)

refs.title: Smiling Head
refs.licence: CC0 (Cleveland Museum of Art Open Access)
refs.reason: the whole face smiling: eyes as narrow slits under a quiet, unknit brow, cheeks full and lifted, lips only just parted; stylised, so structure not look

refs.title: Head of a Woman Looking Up
refs.licence: CC0 (The Met Open Access, public domain)
refs.reason: a woman's head tipped back three-quarter: the jaw's underside and the throat in a soft halftone, never black; the far cheek one quiet turning plane; the neck rising into the shoulders

refs.reason: a soft closed-mouth smile on a frontal head: round cheek pads, the lips' corners lifted without opening; little tilt, so used for the mouth only
